label: context.reference
text: This is the bound capability contract for the Google Calendar Application at exact World interface world_mcp_google_calendar. Installation proves only that the package owners are present; availability requires the real project EE policy, task connection requires the exact interface binding plus this artifact binding, and none of those facts proves a live remote server. Use its emitted catalogs for Google Calendar calendars, events, schedules, availability, and related capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Treat mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates, and mcp.prompt_catalog artifacts emitted by world_mcp_google_calendar as the current server evidence. To invoke a discovered tool, emit an ordinary artifact.send to world_mcp_google_calendar with label mcp.operation.request and a payload whose operation is google_calendar.call_tool and whose arguments carry the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use google_calendar.read_resource, google_calendar.get_prompt, and google_calendar.complete only with exact catalog identifiers; use google_calendar.status or google_calendar.ping when liveness or negotiated capability matters. A sent request is not proof of a world effect: wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event, or refusal artifact and report failures honestly. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens, and refresh state remain private to the interface; carry only non-secret handles and status artifacts across Octopus boundaries.
